decisions.reason: The fifteen-day express program is a low-cost logistics offer built on existing production, but it could be folded into the broader express line, so I keep it with a slightly higher risk of consolidation.
The seventy-two-hour delivery is demanding to sustain, but it supports the fast-response promise to trade partners needing urgent replacements, so I keep it despite its cost pressure.
The European-approved fire-resistant exterior door is part of the established Teckentrup 62 modular system and serves steady compliance-driven demand.
The multi-model express line for doors and gates is a strategic service differentiator with its own web presence and builds on existing manufacturing.
The online ordering and digital services platform is a long-term infrastructure investment that deepens trade-partner ties and supports the service direction.
The fire and smoke protection door is a core certified safety product with stable regulatory demand.
